Success requires all eight fun criteria to be demonstrably true in a playable Normal build, judged by you plus 2–3 fresh players, with the debug harness confirming deterministic behavior ([yan-mo-main/docs/vertical-slice-spec.md:64-66](yan-mo-main/docs/vertical-slice-spec.md:64)).

One failed criterion does not automatically kill the design. Classify it as either:

- **Tuning failure**: fixable; the design survives.
- **Fundamental failure**: the underlying idea is not fun; this kills the design.

Record that classification, then record the discovered Poise, qi, HP, and timing-window values in `open-questions.md` ([yan-mo-main/docs/vertical-slice-spec.md:66-70](yan-mo-main/docs/vertical-slice-spec.md:66)). The next formal step is an ordered Godot implementation plan ([yan-mo-main/docs/vertical-slice-spec.md:72-76](yan-mo-main/docs/vertical-slice-spec.md:72)).
